title: make errors nullable for call signatures of filesystem types
body:
Ref: #11630 
Fixes callback signature types for InputFileSystem and OutputFileSystem. Errors in the callback may be null, but were not marked as such. This PR fixes that.

**What kind of change does this PR introduce?**

bugfix

**Did you add tests for your changes?**

not needed

**Does this PR introduce a breaking change?**

no

**What needs to be documented once your changes are merged?**

nothing
